name: git-knife
tagline: Stab your git history into shape with a spreadsheet-like UI
description: git-knife is an interactive tool that lets you edit commit messages, authors, and dates across your git history as if they were rows in a spreadsheet. Instead of chaining git filter-branch incantations, you manipulate history in a table UI and apply the rewrite. It is the history-rewriting tool that has been missing from the ecosystem, and it hit 163 HN points in a single day.
highlights: Spreadsheet-like table UI for editing commit messages, authors, and dates
Replaces error-prone filter-branch chains with direct manipulation
163 HN points within one day of launch
A genuinely missing tool for git history maintenance
curatorNote: Rewriting git history has always been a terrifying pipeline of one-liners. A table UI where you just edit the rows makes the whole operation legible and safe — surprising nobody had shipped this properly before.
